name: DAX Short DI/FR
pine_code:
/@version=6
strategy("DAX Tuesday/Friday SMA-RSI Short Strategy + Simple Table", overlay=true, pyramiding=0, process_orders_on_close=true, calc_on_every_tick=false, default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=100, commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.0, slippage=0, max_labels_count=500)

// TradingView-friendly daily strategy:
// - Signal is evaluated on the daily close.
// - Entry is at that daily close.
// - Exit is at the next available daily close.
// - Use on the Daily chart.
// - Alerts are sent via alert() calls:
//   1) Entry mail
//   2) Exit-plan mail
// - Strategy order-fill alerts are disabled to avoid duplicate mails.

showSignals = input.bool(true, "Show signal markers", group="Display")
showSmas = input.bool(true, "Plot enabled SMA filters", group="Display")
showTable = input.bool(true, "Show simple status table", group="Display")

tablePositionInput = input.string("Top right", "Table position", options=["Top right", "Top left", "Middle right", "Middle left", "Bottom right", "Bottom left"], group="Display")
tableTextSizeInput = input.string("Small", "Table text size", options=["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large", "Huge"], group="Display")
tableWidth = input.int(12, "Table cell width", minval=0, maxval=40, group="Display")
tableHeight = input.int(3, "Table cell height", minval=0, maxval=20, group="Display")

sendAlertEmails = input.bool(true, "Send entry + exit-plan alert() mails", group="Alerts")

tuesdayGroup = "Tuesday Strategy"
tuesdayEnabled = input.bool(true, "Enabled", group=tuesdayGroup)
tuesdayFilter = input.string("SMA", "Filter", options=["SMA", "RSI"], group=tuesdayGroup)
tuesdayDirection = input.string("Above", "Condition", options=["Above", "Below"], group=tuesdayGroup)
tuesdaySmaLen = input.int(40, "SMA length", minval=1, group=tuesdayGroup)
tuesdayRsiLen = input.int(14, "RSI length", minval=1, group=tuesdayGroup)
tuesdayRsiLevel = input.float(50.0, "RSI threshold", minval=0.0, maxval=100.0, step=0.1, group=tuesdayGroup)

fridayGroup = "Friday Strategy"
fridayEnabled = input.bool(true, "Enabled", group=fridayGroup)
fridayFilter = input.string("RSI", "Filter", options=["SMA", "RSI"], group=fridayGroup)
fridayDirection = input.string("Below", "Condition", options=["Above", "Below"], group=fridayGroup)
fridaySmaLen = input.int(40, "SMA length", minval=1, group=fridayGroup)
fridayRsiLen = input.int(14, "RSI length", minval=1, group=fridayGroup)
fridayRsiLevel = input.float(50.0, "RSI threshold", minval=0.0, maxval=100.0, step=0.1, group=fridayGroup)

f_filter_condition(string filterType, string direction, float refClose, float refSma, float refRsi, float rsiLevel) =>
    float lhs = filterType == "SMA" ? refClose : refRsi
    float rhs = filterType == "SMA" ? refSma : rsiLevel
    bool valid = filterType == "SMA" ? not na(refClose) and not na(refSma) : not na(refRsi)
    bool pass = direction == "Above" ? lhs > rhs : lhs < rhs
    valid and pass

f_valid_text(bool enabled, bool filterOk) =>
    enabled ? filterOk ? "VALID" : "NOT VALID" : "OFF"

f_action_text(string setupName, bool enabled, bool filterOk) =>
    enabled and filterOk ? setupName + " Short Day" : "No action"

f_valid_bg(bool enabled, bool filterOk) =>
    enabled ? filterOk ? color.new(color.green, 20) : color.new(color.gray, 86) : color.new(color.gray, 92)

f_action_bg(bool enabled, bool filterOk) =>
    enabled and filterOk ? color.new(color.red, 18) : color.new(color.gray, 88)

f_table_position(string positionInput) =>
    positionInput == "Top left" ? position.top_left :
     positionInput == "Middle right" ? position.middle_right :
     positionInput == "Middle left" ? position.middle_left :
     positionInput == "Bottom right" ? position.bottom_right :
     positionInput == "Bottom left" ? position.bottom_left :
     position.top_right

f_table_text_size(string sizeInput) =>
    sizeInput == "Tiny" ? size.tiny :
     sizeInput == "Normal" ? size.normal :
     sizeInput == "Large" ? size.large :
     sizeInput == "Huge" ? size.huge :
     size.small

tuesdaySma = ta.sma(close, tuesdaySmaLen)
tuesdayRsi = ta.rsi(close, tuesdayRsiLen)
fridaySma = ta.sma(close, fridaySmaLen)
fridayRsi = ta.rsi(close, fridayRsiLen)

tuesdayFilterValid = f_filter_condition(tuesdayFilter, tuesdayDirection, close, tuesdaySma, tuesdayRsi, tuesdayRsiLevel)
fridayFilterValid = f_filter_condition(fridayFilter, fridayDirection, close, fridaySma, fridayRsi, fridayRsiLevel)

tuesdaySignal = tuesdayEnabled and dayofweek == dayofweek.monday and tuesdayFilterValid
fridaySignal = fridayEnabled and dayofweek == dayofweek.thursday and fridayFilterValid
shortSignal = tuesdaySignal or fridaySignal

entryAlertMessage = tuesdaySignal ? "ENTRY: DAX Tuesday Short now at Monday Daily Close." :
     fridaySignal ? "ENTRY: DAX Friday Short now at Thursday Daily Close." :
     "ENTRY: DAX Short now at Daily Close."

exitPlanAlertMessage = tuesdaySignal ? "EXIT PLAN: Close the Tuesday Short tomorrow at Tuesday Daily Close." :
     fridaySignal ? "EXIT PLAN: Close the Friday Short tomorrow at Friday Daily Close." :
     "EXIT PLAN: Close this Short on the next trading day at Daily Close."

var int shortEntryBar = na
exitSignal = strategy.position_size < 0 and not na(shortEntryBar) and bar_index > shortEntryBar

if shortSignal and strategy.position_size == 0
    if sendAlertEmails
        alert(entryAlertMessage, alert.freq_all)
        alert(exitPlanAlertMessage, alert.freq_all)
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short, comment=entryAlertMessage, alert_message=entryAlertMessage, disable_alert=true)
    shortEntryBar := bar_index

if exitSignal
    strategy.close("Short", comment="Close Short", disable_alert=true)
    shortEntryBar := na

if strategy.position_size == 0 and not shortSignal and not exitSignal
    shortEntryBar := na

plotshape(showSignals and tuesdaySignal, title="Tuesday Short Signal", style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.red, text="Tue", textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(showSignals and fridaySignal, title="Friday Short Signal", style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.red, text="Fri", textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(showSignals and exitSignal, title="Close Short", style=shape.xcross, location=location.belowbar, color=color.gray, text="Close", textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)

plot(showSmas and tuesdayEnabled and tuesdayFilter == "SMA" ? tuesdaySma : na, title="Tuesday SMA", color=color.rgb(20, 20, 20), linewidth=1)
plot(showSmas and fridayEnabled and fridayFilter == "SMA" ? fridaySma : na, title="Friday SMA", color=color.rgb(182, 129, 30), linewidth=1)

alertcondition(tuesdaySignal, title="Tuesday short entry", message="DAX Tuesday Short Entry at Daily Close")
alertcondition(fridaySignal, title="Friday short entry", message="DAX Friday Short Entry at Daily Close")
alertcondition(shortSignal, title="Short entry", message="DAX Tuesday/Friday Short Entry at Daily Close")

var table statusTable = table.new(f_table_position(tablePositionInput), 3, 3, bgcolor=color.new(color.white, 0), frame_color=color.new(color.gray, 72), frame_width=1, border_color=color.new(color.gray, 88), border_width=1)

tableTextSize = f_table_text_size(tableTextSizeInput)

if showTable and (barstate.islast or barstate.islastconfirmedhistory)
    color headerBg = color.rgb(18, 24, 38)
    color subBg = color.rgb(241, 245, 249)
    table.cell(statusTable, 0, 0, "Setup", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=headerBg, text_size=tableTextSize, width=tableWidth, height=tableHeight)
    table.cell(statusTable, 1, 0, "Filter", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=headerBg, text_size=tableTextSize, width=tableWidth, height=tableHeight)
    table.cell(statusTable, 2, 0, "Action", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=headerBg, text_size=tableTextSize, width=tableWidth, height=tableHeight)
    table.cell(statusTable, 0, 1, "Tuesday", bgcolor=subBg, text_size=tableTextSize, width=tableWidth, height=tableHeight)
    table.cell(statusTable, 1, 1, f_valid_text(tuesdayEnabled, tuesdayFilterValid), bgcolor=f_valid_bg(tuesdayEnabled, tuesdayFilterValid), text_color=tuesdayFilterValid ? color.white : color.rgb(20, 20, 20), text_size=tableTextSize, width=tableWidth, height=tableHeight)
    table.cell(statusTable, 2, 1, f_action_text("Tuesday", tuesdayEnabled, tuesdayFilterValid), bgcolor=f_action_bg(tuesdayEnabled, tuesdayFilterValid), text_color=tuesdayEnabled and tuesdayFilterValid ? color.white : color.rgb(20, 20, 20), text_size=tableTextSize, width=tableWidth, height=tableHeight)
    table.cell(statusTable, 0, 2, "Friday", bgcolor=subBg, text_size=tableTextSize, width=tableWidth, height=tableHeight)
    table.cell(statusTable, 1, 2, f_valid_text(fridayEnabled, fridayFilterValid), bgcolor=f_valid_bg(fridayEnabled, fridayFilterValid), text_color=fridayFilterValid ? color.white : color.rgb(20, 20, 20), text_size=tableTextSize, width=tableWidth, height=tableHeight)
    table.cell(statusTable, 2, 2, f_action_text("Friday", fridayEnabled, fridayFilterValid), bgcolor=f_action_bg(fridayEnabled, fridayFilterValid), text_color=fridayEnabled and fridayFilterValid ? color.white : color.rgb(20, 20, 20), text_size=tableTextSize, width=tableWidth, height=tableHeight)
else if not showTable and (barstate.islast or barstate.islastconfirmedhistory)
    table.clear(statusTable, 0, 0, 2, 2)
